## Problem Description

What problem are you trying to solve? Is it related to a specific adapter, the routing policy,
configuration, or something else?

## Desired Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, links, or examples here. If relevant, note whether this fits within an
existing architectural boundary (see `ARCHITECTURE.md` §8 Architectural Rules) — e.g. a new
agent adapter shouldn't require touching `core/`.
